Commentary.Commentary: This ends the proceedings of the ICC Champions Trophy, 2017. It was an amazing tournament with top 8 teams of the world pitted against each other. It had all the twists and turns and beating all the odds, Pakistan became the newly crowned champions. India also had a good tournament but fell short at the last hurdle. They now will look to make amends in the tour of West Indies. Hope you enjoyed our coverage of this tournament. So until next time, it's goodbye and goodnight from us. Take care! Cheers!

Sarfraz Ahmed thanks the Almighty for winning the tournament. Reckons that after losing the first game against India, he told his boys that the tournament is not over yet. Mentions that they responded really well. Credits Fakhar Zaman for the way he played in his first ICC tournament. Informs that his bowlers bowled really well and applauds all of them for bowling terrifically. Adds that credit goes to everyone in his team for giving their all in the field. Adds that no one recognized Pakistan in world cricket but now people will as they have been crowned champions. Ends by thanking his supporters for being with them throughout.

Virat Kohli congratulates Pakistan cricket team and their fans. Mentions that they turned things around superbly and they can beat anyone on their day. Informs that he has a smile on his face because of his team's performance in this tournament and he is proud of them. Adds that they were more intense and passionate and they outplayed the Indians. With the ball, he says they had a few wicket-taking opportunities but couldn't make it count. Applauds Hardik Pandya's knock. On that wicket of Zaman off the no ball from Bumrah, he says that small margins can be massive in cricket and they have to learn from their mistakes and move on. On the pitch, he mentions that it was consistent throughout. Ends by saying that they backed their strength but they just weren't good on the day and have to get their act back together.

Man of the Tournament and the Golden Ball Award winner (13 wickets), Hasan Ali thanks the Almighty for winning this tournament. Reckons that he has worked hard to reach this level. Mentions that he was calm throughout the game. Informs that he is really happy with the way he bowled in this tournament. Ends by saying that it was really special to take the last wicket of the game.
FAKHAR ZAMAN is awarded the Man of the Match for his sensational century in the pressure game. SHIKHAR DHAWAN wins the Golden Bat Award for scoring 338 runs in the ICC Champions Trophy 2017.

Azhar Mahmood says that Hasan Ali is a young guy and always wants to run in hard, he is a match winner for them. On Fakhar Zaman, he says that it's more about self belief and mental strength for him. Adds that he puts pressure on the opposition and these are good signs for the team.

Mickey Arthur says that he is proud of his players and they have achieved something incredible. Adds that they aren't as consistent as other teams but have a fantastic group of players. Informs that qualifying for the 2019 World Cup was their first aim and now they have got enough points in their kitty.

Shoaib Malik says that it's hard to describe the feeling in words. Mentions that people at home would be up and celebrating. Dedicates this trophy to the supporters and also applauds India's performances in this tournament. Informs that he wasn't nervous and being the senior cricketer, he had to stay calm to set an example for the juniors.

Imad Wasim says that winning the trophy is unbelievable and that too an ICC event, nothing gets better than it. Thanks the supporters for their support throughout the tournament. Ends by saying that the captaincy was superb.
Mohammad Amir says that it was about team work and everyone played well. Adds that the win against South Africa was the game-changer.

Mohammad Hafeez says that their openers set up the platform for them. Adds that he wanted to express himself and wanted to do something for the nation. Ends by saying that there was something missing to inspire the country and this will lift the whole nation up.

Pakistan came into the match seeded last and lost their very first match with a big margin against the same opponent. Since that game everything went their way and they produced some amazing performances which have landed them in a glorious position. They deserve all of it. Cricket is a game of uncertainties and this tournament just proved it.

None of the Indian batsmen stood up against the fierce Pakistani bowlers except Hardik Pandya who clobbered them all around the park. Although, a confusion in the middle cost him his wicket and that was it for India. Shadab Khan and Hasan Ali also bowled brilliantly and backed the good work of their opening bowlers well.

339 was a steep target but no one would have ruled out India with the firepower they possess with the bat. Pakistan, however, came out in the second innings with the same determination and it was quite visible on the field. Mohammad Amir and Junaid Khan made the ball talk with the former sending the Indian top order back in the hut in a jiffy.

Pakistan have scripted history as they have won the ICC Champions Trophy for the first time ever. They were exceptional from the start of the day. The only thing which went against them was the toss. After losing the toss, they were put to bat first. The Pakistani batters stood up and fantastic knocks from Fakhar Zaman, Azhar Ali and Mohammad Hafeez helped them post a solid total.

OUT! PAKISTAN ARE THE CHAMPIONS! Banged in short, angling in, Bumrah is caught by surprise and just hangs his bat. The ball lobs off the gloves in the slip cordon. Sarfraz hops to take the catch and completes the proceedings and the players start celebrating. Pakistan win by 180 runs and this is India's biggest defeat against the Men in Green in the ODIs.

Back of a length delivery outside off, defended solidly.

In the air...Safe! Slower delivery outside off, Bhuvneshwar Kumar throws his bat at it. Gets it off the outer half and the ball flies over the cover region. Two fielders try getting under it but no one is able to reach it. The batsmen run a single.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Hasan Ali is finishing off the tail. Good length delivery outside off and Ashwin flashes at it. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies straight to the keeper. Sarfraz Ahmed makes no mistake and Ashwin has to walk back. Hasan Ali celebrates in an emphatic fashion as he senses glory.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, Kumar lets it through to the keeper.
Kumar stays in his crease and defends it.

OUT! Jadeja departs! Good length delivery outside off, he tries to flay at it. Gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball flies straight towards the fielder at first slip. Babar Azam takes it comfortably to send Jadeja back. Junaid Khan strikes and India are on the brink of a big defeat.
Good length delivery outside off, Ashwin guides it towards third man for a single.

OUT! What a big mix-up! Length delivery outside off, Jadeja taps it towards the cover region. Hardik Pandya feels that there is a run there and he starts running. Hafeez collects it quickly and throws it back to Hasan Ali who dislodges the bails. Jadeja did not even try running as he was in his crease. Hardik Pandya has to depart after such a fantastic knock. The replays show that Jadeja took a couple of steps ahead and then turned back. This is not a good sign for India. Pandya walks back furious. Perhaps, the southpaw could have sacrificed his wickets. The Pakistan camp has got their smile back as this ends the counter-attacking 80-run stand.
Length delivery outside off, Jadeja bunts it towards the fielder at point.

Quicker outside off, Pandya lets it through.
Full toss delivery, pushed towards long on for a single.

Fuller into the pads, Jadeja clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

Jadeja defends it on the off side and scampers across for a quick single.
Pandya pushes it towards covers for a quick single.

Fuller around leg, Jadeja nudges it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

Pandya drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
2nd ODI fifty for Hardik Pandya!

SIX! Wrong' un tossed outside off, Pandya reads it well and sends that deep into the long on stands for half a dozen.
SIX! Pandya, you beauty! Fuller into the pads, Pandya waits for it and slogs it powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.

Quicker into the pads, Jadeja clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

FOUR! Good shot! Short outside off, Hardik Pandya punches it through the cover region for a boundary. 100 up for India.
Short around off, Jadeja punches it towards long on for a single.
Pandya drives it towards covers. The fielder there misjudges it completely which allows them a single.

Even the magic pill doesn't work for Imad Wasim. He was struggling a bit before and now he can't continue. Fakhar Zaman to continue his over.
Another slider from Wasim, defended on the leg side.
Sliding into the pads, turned on the leg side for a brace.
Full around off, driven off the front foot to long off for a single.

NOT OUT! Served outside off, Pandya taps it in covers and takes off for a quick single. Jadeja, however, sends him back. The fielder there throws a little high towards the keeper, who takes the bails off and appeals. The replay shows that Pandya is well in. The skipper was furious with his fielder there.
There's an appeal for a run out at the striker's end and the umpire has gone upstairs to have a look at it. Hardik seems fine though!

SIX! Thump! Shadab tosses it up, Pandya clears his front leg and clobbers it over long on for a maximum. Hardik is looking really solid out there. However, he has to play big to win the game for his team.

Straying on the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.

Shortish delivery outside off, cut past backward point for a brace.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
The Indian fans are seen leaving the stadium. Surely not good signs these. Meanwhile, Ravindra Jadeja walks out to the middle.

OUT! In the air... Gone! Another one bites the dust. Leg spinner from Shadab on the shorter side. Jadhav clears his front leg, looks to pull it away on the leg side but the ball spins a long way with slight extra bounce. Catches the top edge and the ball skies in the short cover region. Tossed up outside off, driven to covers.

Angling into the batsman, played to mid on again.
Length delivery, angling in, punched to mid on.
Banged in short, Jadhav leaves it alone.
Pitched outside off, pushed through cover for a single.
Defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Khan drags his length back, Jadhav picks the length quickly, latches onto it in a flash and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pandya turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Another fine stop by Shadab at point. Short delivery was cut fiercely but Khan made a superb stop.
Hardik Pandya strides out to the middle.

Time for Drinks! India are in a depleted state currently. Half their side is back in the hut and Pakistan are cruising at the moment. India, on the other hand, will want something really special to chase it down.

OUT! Dhoni holes out! India have lost half their side in 14 overs. Short delivery by Hasan, angling in. Dhoni goes for the pull but the ball gets big on him. Gets a top edge and the ball travels over mid-wicket. Wasim in the deep, runs ahead and takes a superb catch diving forward. The Indian fans in the stadium can't believe their eyes. The defending champions are falling like a pack of cards. Pakistan need just 5 wickets now to win.

Superb stop, Shadab! Take a bow young lad. Took the wicket a couple of deliviries ago and now made an exceptional stop to back his mate. Coming back to the ball, Dhoni punches it through point and Shadab makes an exceptional stop.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Kedar Jadhav is the new man in.

OUT! Successful review! What a call this from Shadab Khan. He was confident all the way and made his skipper take the review. Leg spinner around off, Yuvraj leans ahead to defend with bat and pad close. There are two sounds as the ball rolls on the off side. The players appeal but it's turned down. The leggie says it's pad first and hence his skipper takes the review. The Hot Spot shows that it's pad first and the Hawk Eye shows that the impact is in line and going on to hit the stumps. This was a good setup by Shadab. Using his variation to the fullest. Huge blow, this! Pakistan are on cloud nine!
An appeal against Yuvraj has been turned down. Shadab Khan, however, is very confident and has compelled his skipper in taking the review.
Wrong 'un around off, Yuvraj prods forward to defend but gets beaten by the away turn.
Dhoni makes a huge stride forward and pushes it through covers for a single.
Leg spinner outside off, Dhoni advances ahead and pushes it on the off side.

Pitched outside off, Dhoni makes another leave.

Yuvraj is holding his hand and seems to be in a lot of pain. The physio has come out to attend him.

As expected, Hasan Ali comes on, replacing Hafeez.

Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now, 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over.
FOUR! Another top shot! Short outside off, Yuvraj Singh punches it through the cover region for a boundary. 14 runs off the over.
FOUR! Good shot! Yuvraj Singh charges down the track and strokes it through the mid on region for a boundary.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Leg bye! Fuller into the pads, Yuvraj Singh fails to clip it through. Gets hit full on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no and the ball goes towards short fine leg. A leg bye is taken.

Gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies towards the keeper. Ahmed accepts it gleefully and the top run-scorer of the ICC Champions Trophy 2017 is on his way back. Pakistan are on top of the game now. Amir has shattered the Indian top-order and he has taken a 3-fer.

The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

If they were good with the bat and the ball till now, they are even fielding well. Fuller into the stumps, Dhawan drives it down the ground. Malik dives to his right from mid on and stops a certain boundary.

Length delivery around off, Yuvraj drives it back to the bowler.

Short delivery outside off, Yuvraj sways away from the line of the ball.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Yuvraj Singh defends it neatly.
Good length delivery outside off, Yuvraj Singh defends it on the off side.

Shadab Khan goes to his right and takes a really fine catch to send the dangerman back to the hut. The best chaser of the game has to walk back to the hut. After getting a life, everyone expected him to rise but the dropped catch has cost nothing. Amir will be really happy and he gets rewarded for bowling fantastic lengths.

Dropped! Amir does all the hard work but Azhar Ali does not support him. Length delivery outside off, Kohli prods forward in defence. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies towards Azhar Ali who cannot hold onto it. Could be a turning point in the context of the match.

Virat Kohli will bat at number 3!

OUT! Rohit Sharma departs on a duck! On a length around leg, the ball nips back in. Sharma fails to clip it through and gets hit flush on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire responds by raising his dreaded finger. He has a talk with his partner but he is not that keen for a review. The umpire tells them that the time is over and Rohit has to walk back to the hut. Replays show that even if they had opted for the review, the umpire's decision would have stayed as it was clipping the top of middle stump.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball swings away. Rohit Sharma shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off to start with, Rohit Sharma gets an inside edge onto his body.

Welcome back for the chase! Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma will open the batting for India. Mohammad Amir will start the proceedings with the first new ball for Pakistan. With two slips in place. Here we go...
